verdict.rationale: Chargebee runs some processes autonomously in the background. Dunning sends reminder emails and schedules payment retries, and Smart retry adjusts retry intervals based on decline type. Events fire configured webhooks, so users can build event-driven automations with external tooling. However, the AI features shown (MCP servers, in-UI AI) are interactive and client-driven, not background agents. Missing for 10: a user-configurable automation or workflow builder, AI agents that run autonomously or on a schedule, and independent or hands-on evidence of background automation.
